info.title: geoconvert - convert maps between geospatial formats.
info.description: Command line converter for map formats, built on GeoConvert.

options.name: --simplify
options.description:
Tolerance units depend on the method: a perpendicular distance
in coordinate degrees for douglas-peucker, an effective triangle
area in degrees² for visvalingam. Larger drops more detail.
Points pass through; polygons stay valid (closed, >= a triangle).

options.name: --simplify-topology
options.description:
Preserve shared boundaries: with two adjacent polygons that
share a border, plain simplification thins each side
independently and the simplified edges no longer line up
(hairline gaps / overlapping alpha). This flag splits each
ring at junction vertices and simplifies each shared arc
once. Ignored without --simplify.

options.name: --size
options.description: Image size in pixels (PNG/SVG output only).

options.name: --max-dimension
options.description:
PNG/SVG only: cap the longer edge at this many pixels and derive
the shorter from the aspect ratio (fit within an N×N box).
Overrides --size when set.

options.name: --projection
options.description:
Projection for PNG/SVG output: 'auto' (default — picks
lambert for regional bounds, plate-carree for continental,
goode for world), 'plate-carree', 'web-mercator', 'lambert'
(Lambert Conformal Conic, low distortion at country/state
scale), or 'goode' (Goode's Homolosine, equal-area world map).

options.name: --renderer
options.description:
PNG only: which rasterizer to use. 'builtin' (default) is the
dependency-free software renderer; 'skia' uses SkiaSharp and
'imagesharp' uses SixLabors.ImageSharp (both add a third-party
dependency and draw labels with a native system font).

options.name: --label
options.description:
PNG/SVG only: render each feature's property value as a text label
(single-stroke vector font; printable ASCII plus Latin
diacritics, ligatures like ß/æ/ø render as '?'). Polygon/line
labels centre on the centroid / midpoint; point labels walk an
8-position ring (Imhof) around the dot, preferring upper-right.
Off-canvas and overlapping labels are dropped silently.

options.name: --label-size
options.description: Cap height of label text in pixels. Default 14.

options.name: --label-color
options.description: Label text color, '#RRGGBB' or '#RRGGBBAA'. Default near-black.

options.name: --label-halo
--label-knockout
options.description:
Solid-fill backdrop painted over each label's bounding
box before the halo and text — the "knockout" style that
erases (or, for a semi-transparent colour, dims) the geometry
under the label. Default off; pass 'none' to keep it off.
Pair with '--label-halo none' for a flat rectangle backdrop.
